integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the XLindley and two-sum construction, PTS-XL PMF, moments, dispersion index, PGF, and conclusion. The prior PXL article was inspected at its mixed-Poisson definition and dispersion discussion, and general mixed-Poisson literature was compared for the variance identity. The convolution proof is analytic, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The convolution representation uses the equal-parameter XLindley summands in the source definition.
The result concerns exact population dispersion and does not deny that a fitted finite dataset can have an empirical dispersion ratio close to one.
It does not compare separately optimized predictive performance of PTS-XL and PXL.
title: The PTS-XL law is a self-convolution and is strictly overdispersed
